cases.description: Explicit anchors take no part in the numbering, so `## Corge `, `## Corge`, `## Corge ` and `## Corge` give the derived anchors `corge`, `corge-1`, `corge-2` and `corge-3`, listed with the explicit `corge` and `corge-1` that duplicate two of them (§6.1, step 7); GitHub gives `corge-`, `corge`, `corge--1` and `corge-1`, since it keeps the space next to the anchor element (decision C13).

`check` reports the explicit `corge-1` of the third heading as a duplicate of the second heading’s derived `corge-1` (§6.1, decision C16), and the section keys `corge` of the second and fourth headings as duplicate keys, the first key `corge` being the first heading’s anchor (§5.5, §5.7).
